commands.message: Use `bun run test`: the suites run under Vitest and node --test, not Bun's own runner.
Force pushes are blocked here, --force-with-lease included (.claude/hooks/block-dangerous-git.sh). Push a new commit instead.
A mirror push overwrites every remote ref. Push your branch by name.
Deleting a remote branch is the person's call; merged branches are deleted by GitHub.
A +refspec is a force push. Push a new commit instead.
reset --hard discards work. Use git reset --soft, or restore your own files by name.
A forced clean deletes untracked work. Remove your own files by name; git clean -n previews.
Forced branch deletion loses unmerged commits. Use git branch -d.
This discards every change in the tree. Restore your own files by name.
History rewrites and reflog pruning are blocked here.
A production deploy is afo's to run (docs/decisions.md, 2026-11-21). Print the plan without --execute instead.
EAS schema registration is afo's to run. register-schemas --check is read-only.

paths.message: The generator is frozen per version: changing its output needs a version bump and a docs/decisions.md entry.
